description: A pbhh.net wall post (or a reply to one).

main.description: A pbhh.net post. Shaped like app.bsky.feed.post, plus a title and site-specific length limits.

title.description: Optional title, rendered above the body. Corresponds to posts.title; this site caps it at 100 graphemes.

content.description: Markdown body. Corresponds to posts.content; this site caps it at 1000 graphemes.

createdAt.description: Original publication timestamp. Corresponds to posts.created_at.

reply.description: Present only on replies; absent on top-level posts.
